userStories.notes: Audited 2026-05-19. docs/audit-area-b.md created with ### Eloquent Model section. Effort L. Model structurally extends Phalcon\Mvc\Model — largest single leak in Area B, plus signature-level leaks on all()/rawFind()/find()/findFirst()/assign() (return Phalcon\Mvc\Model\ResultsetInterface or ModelInterface) and ?Phalcon\Di\DiInterface params on query()/newQuery*(). No real Phare model contract — ModelInterface is a 1-method toArray() stub and not implemented. Major behavioural divergences: Phare::create() is INSTANCE returning bool (Laravel: static, returns Model); $guarded default ['*'] silently no-ops mass assignment when neither fillable nor guarded set (Laravel default []); all()/find() return Phalcon ResultsetInterface not Eloquent Collection; firstOrFail throws PhModel\Exception not ModelNotFoundException. Missing: $with/$withCount/load*/loadMissing eager-load, *OrFail/updateQuietly/pushQuietly/destroy/fresh/refresh/replicate, toJson/jsonSerialize/__toString (not Jsonable/JsonSerializable), $keyType/$incrementing API, strict-mode guards, HasUuids/HasUlids. Custom-cast classes ship in Eloquent/Casts/ but castAttribute() never invokes the CastsAttributes contract — likely correctness gap.

Second pillar of the Eloquent facade — structurally welded to Phalcon\Mvc\Model\Criteria AND BuilderInterface extends Phalcon\Mvc\Model\CriteriaInterface (Phalcon interface baked into Phare's published contract — worse than US-B01). Signature-level Phalcon leaks on get()/first()/last() (return Phalcon\Mvc\ModelInterface / ResultsetInterface). Missing ~60/93 Eloquent Builder methods (find*/firstOr*/sole/value/value chunks/createOrFirst/updateOrCreate/upsert/touch/whereHas family/withCount/withSum) and ~180/228 Query Builder methods (aggregates, joins, HAVING, whereDate/Json/Exists/Any/All, insert*/upsert/truncate, toSql/getBindings, simplePaginate/cursorPaginate/chunk/each/lazy). No $passthru — Model::query()->count()/->toSql()/->exists() throw BadMethodCallException. Correctness defects: paginate($page,$limit): BuilderInterface (Laravel: paginate($perPage,...): LengthAwarePaginator — INVERTED arg order, opposite return); update(array) builds raw UPDATE SQL via getWriteConnection bypassing model events/mutators; delete() iterates N round-trips; select()/addSelect() CSV explode/implode corrupts comma-bearing expressions; isOperator() recognises 11 ops vs Laravel's 30+ (Postgres/MySQL ops silently mis-bind); last() is non-Laravel + Phalcon leak.

userStories.notes: Audited 2026-05-26. ### Seeders + Factories appended to docs/audit-area-b.md (+168 lines). Effort L — architecture inversion, not backfill. Phare ships Seeder (abstract, raw-SQL create/table/SeederTable helpers) + Factory (concrete container-bound RUNTIME service returning plain ARRAYS, not model instances) + BaseFactory (abstract: only definition()+faker()). NO HasFactory trait, NO Model::factory(), NO make:factory cmd, NO Sequence/relationship factories. Seeder missing ~7/8 Laravel public methods (callWith/callSilent/callOnce+$called dedup/setContainer/setCommand/resolve/__invoke + WithoutModelEvents); call() is protected/no-silent/no-params/no-DI. Factory missing ~45/50 methods (static new/times, raw, makeOne/Many, createOne/Many/*Quietly, lazy, insert, has/hasAttached/for-as-parent/recycle, sequence family, configure, connection, prependState/set, namespace statics). Phalcon leaks: PUBLIC-SIGNATURE SeederTable::__construct(AbstractPdo) (first true §2 sig leak here) + published-dependency Seeder::$db/Factory::$db typed AbstractPdo (no Connection wrapper — same root cause as B05); BaseFactory Phalcon-CLEAN. Defects: Factory.create() raw INSERT never instantiates model (skips casts/mutators/events/timestamps/PK back-fill — raw-SQL-bypass family B02/B03/B04); getTableName() naive strtolower+'s' breaks irregular plurals & ignores $table; BaseFactory.faker() new generator per call (perf+non-reproducible); no callOnce dedup / partial-seed swallow in SeedCommand; FactoryNotFound exception is dead code. NEW same-name/opposite-meaning hazard: Factory::for() SETS model vs Laravel for()=parent belongsTo relationship (running list: B01 create, B02 paginate, B05 rollback, B06 for). Blocked partly on B01/B02 model/builder fixes upstream.

userStories.notes: Audited 2026-05-26. ### Pagination appended to docs/audit-area-b.md. Effort L. SUBSYSTEM IS PHALCON-CLEAN (zero Phalcon refs in all 5 files — first fully clean Area-B subsystem in BOTH namespace AND inheritance; Wrapper Rule PASSES). Cursor is the closest-to-parity file (1:1 with Laravel). BUT the whole namespace is ORPHANED (new defect class): Builder::paginate($page,$limit):BuilderInterface only sets limit/offset and returns the Builder — never constructs a paginator; no Builder::simplePaginate/cursorPaginate; nothing under src/Phare/Eloquent/ does `new LengthAwarePaginator/Paginator/CursorPaginator`; only Http\Resources\ResourceCollection consumes via instanceof. UrlWindow is also orphaned (linkCollection/defaultView iterate range(1,lastPage) → unbounded link list; the shipped onEachSide windowing is never called). Collapsed abstract layer: Paginator IS the base (no AbstractPaginator), CursorPaginator has no shared base → query/fragment helpers copy-pasted. Missing: no Contracts\Pagination\*; base Paginator has no links/render/hasMorePagesWhen/onLastPage; CursorPaginator has no render/links/cursor()/resolveCurrentCursor (can't read incoming cursor); no ArrayAccess, no __call ForwardsCalls, no loadMorph*, no view factory / Tailwind|Bootstrap presets / PaginationServiceProvider / Blade templates (render() returns hardcoded inline HTML — stub/hardcoded-output family). Naming hazards: LengthAwarePaginator::simplePaginate():string (Laravel: a Builder method returning a Paginator); items() returns Collection on Paginator but array on CursorPaginator (Laravel: always array). toArray drift: base adds non-Laravel current_page_url. Effort L because unwired end-to-end — closing it is blocked on B02 (working builder) + A07 (view stack).

userStories.notes: Audited 2026-05-27. docs/audit-area-c.md created with ### AuthManager section. Effort L — architecture inversion + backfill. Phare AuthManager extends generic Support\Manager; exposes only guard()/getDefaultDriver() of the Laravel Factory surface (10/14 missing: shouldUse/setDefaultDriver/viaRequest/userResolver/resolveUsersUsing/provider/hasResolvedGuards/forgetGuards/setApplication/createTokenDriver). NO Contracts\Auth\Factory/Guard/StatefulGuard/UserProvider in Phare. Session guard is named Phare\Auth\Manager (10 pub methods vs Laravel SessionGuard's ~31) — no remember-me, no basic auth, no once, no setUser/hasUser/getUser, no Timebox, no Hasher injection (raw password_verify), no Recaller cookie. NO UserProvider abstraction (no EloquentUserProvider/DatabaseUserProvider/GenericUser/CreatesUserProviders); auth.providers.*.driver is parsed but ignored — stub-defect at config level. Authenticatable contract makes getAuthIdentifierName/getAuthPasswordName static (Laravel: instance) — 6th same-name/opposite-shape porting hazard. AuthenticationException missing $guards/$redirectTo/guards()/redirectTo(). Phalcon leaks: (1) public-signature Manager::__construct(Session, Phalcon\Config\ConfigInterface, ...) — published-dependency leak, same shape as B05/B06 AbstractPdo leaks but on ConfigInterface; (2) public-signature union return Manager::loginUsingId(int): User|\Phalcon\Mvc\ModelInterface — same shape as B03 HasRelationships factories; (3) AuthServiceProvider implements Phalcon\Di\ServiceProviderInterface — provider-boundary contract coupling, same as A07 BladeViewProvider. Silent-arg-drop family extends: attempt/login/loginUsingId all drop Laravel's $remember (makes the remember-me protocol unreachable). Hidden coupling: AuthManager::__call → default guard → Sanctum::setUser blows up unless default guard is SanctumGuard. Bindings: 'auth' + non-Laravel 'auth.manager'.

userStories.notes: Audited 2026-05-27. ### Session Auth appended to docs/audit-area-c.md (+~310 lines). Effort L. Drills into Manager (session-guard runtime), Session/SessionManager + SessionStoreManager, Contracts/Session/Session. 10 pub methods on Manager vs ~31 on Laravel SessionGuard; missing Recaller + remember-me wholesale (continuation of silent-arg-drop), missing 5-method GuardHelpers trait surface (authenticate/hasUser/setUser/forgetUser/getProvider/setProvider), missing 7 SessionGuard methods (attemptWhen/once/onceUsingId/basic/onceBasic/logoutCurrentDevice/logoutOtherDevices/attempting/viaRemember/getLastAttempted/getName/getRecallerName/setRememberDuration/hashPasswordForCookie/getCookieJar/setCookieJar/getDispatcher/setDispatcher/getSession/getRequest/setRequest/getTimebox). Events 6/8 (missing CurrentDeviceLogout/OtherDeviceLogout, and ALL Phare event ctors drop $guard name; Attempting/Login also drop $remember — multi-guard listeners can't disambiguate). SessionManager extends Phalcon\Session\Manager (inheritance leak ➍) + Contracts\Session\Session extends Phalcon\Session\ManagerInterface (contract leak ➌, NEW for C02). Session\Store coverage ~18/54 — entire flash family missing (which kills the A05/A06 redirect-back-with-errors flow). SessionStoreManager covers 3/10 drivers, no extend(), no EncryptedStore wrapping. 7th same-name/opposite-shape porting hazard: Manager::login(User): bool vs Laravel SessionGuard::login(...): void. NEW behavioural defects (all flagged for US-S01): §1 logout() destroys ENTIRE session not just auth key — logout blast-radius defect; §2 raw password_verify, no Timebox / no Hasher / no rehashPasswordIfRequired — security defect on three axes (timing-attack, no hash-algo upgrade path, Hasher not pluggable); §3 session-key collision risk when auth.session_id is set globally (no per-class sha1); §4 regenerateId() omits the deleteOldSession flag — session-fixation mitigation gap; §7 SessionStoreManager::store() eagerly calls $session->start() at resolve-time so queue/console workers write cookies; §8 `session` and `session.manager` container bindings return DIFFERENT SessionManager instances (wiring divergence). Five leak forms overlapping with prior areas; only NEW leak class introduced is the Session contract leak ➌. Partly blocked on US-C03 Hashing, US-C04 Encrypter (recaller cookie payload), US-C05 CSRF (session-token API), US-E03 Config.

userStories.notes: Audited 2026-05-27. ### Hashing appended to docs/audit-area-c.md. Effort M — smallest Area-C surface (6 files, 8 public manager methods, 4 hasher methods on the contract) but security-critical. Phare ships HasherInterface (inside Hashing namespace, NOT under Contracts/), HashManager extends Support\Manager with 4 driver factories (bcrypt/argon/argon2i/argon2id), BcryptHasher, ArgonHasher, Argon2iHasher, Argon2idHasher. Subsystem namespace is Phalcon-CLEAN; leaks live in the out-of-namespace provider only — same pattern as A07/C01/C02 (4th consecutive subsystem with this shape). Leaks: ➀ HashServiceProvider implements Phalcon\Di\ServiceProviderInterface (provider-boundary, recurs A07/C01/C02); ➁ HashServiceProvider::register(Application|DiInterface $app) published-dependency leak on Phalcon\Di\DiInterface (same family as B05/B06/C01). Security defects: (1) BcryptHasher default rounds=10 vs Laravel 12 — ~4× weaker hashes on fresh install; (2) zero #[\SensitiveParameter] annotations — passwords leak into stack traces; (3) no $verifyAlgorithm field anywhere — cross-algorithm verify silently false-pass not raise; (4) no bcrypt $limit / InvalidArgumentException — 72-byte truncation undetectable, two users with same first 72 bytes verify against each other; (5) no sodium-provider thread-count override — needsRehash returns true forever on sodium builds (infinite-rehash loop). Correctness defects: §2 driver factories ignore hashing.bcrypt/hashing.argon config — silent-config-dropthrough (same family as B03 attach $touch); no default config/hashing.php ships; §1 NEW behavioural defect — `argon` and `argon2i` driver names both resolve to PASSWORD_ARGON2I (Phare has 4 driver names, Laravel 3) — dead driver, name divergence. Missing: HashManager::isHashed/verifyConfiguration, BcryptHasher::verifyConfiguration/isUsingCorrectAlgorithm/isUsingValidOptions, ArgonHasher::setMemory/setTime/setThreads/verifyConfiguration, Argon2IdHasher::check override, 'hash.driver' binding, DeferrableProvider+provides(), bcrypt() global helper, Hash facade, Contracts\Hashing\Hasher publication. Type-mismatch: HashManager::extend(Closure|HasherInterface) WIDENS Laravel's Closure-only contract — porting hazard (Phare→Laravel direction). HashManager ctor accepts string|ContainerContract|null — boundary widened (no-container mode breaks extend() with $this->config). Cross-cuts US-C02 §2 (rehashPasswordIfRequired hook), US-E02 (DeferrableProvider/ServiceProvider base), US-E03 (Config wrapper for verifyConfiguration), US-E05 (Hash facade), US-E06 (bcrypt helper).

Encrypter namespace is Phalcon-CLEAN by inheritance + namespace (Phare\Encryption\Encrypter implements no contract, but uses pure openssl/random_bytes). Leaks shift to the OUT-OF-NAMESPACE provider and helpers (recurs A07/C01/C02/C03): ➀ EncrypterProvider implements Phalcon\Di\ServiceProviderInterface; ➁ register(Application|DiInterface $app) published-dependency leak; ➂ NEW DI-slot leak — 'encrypter' binding resolves to Phalcon\Encryption\Crypt (NOT the Phare class), so every app('encrypter') consumer gets the Phalcon class with encryptBase64/decryptBase64 (incompatible wire format with Laravel); ➃ NEW helper-return-type leak — Support\helpers.php::encrypter(): Crypt publishes Phalcon class in return type. Dual-stack: Phare\Encryption\Encrypter is wired NOWHERE except a single direct `new Encrypter(...)` in Eloquent\Concerns\HasAttributes::resolveAttributeEncrypter() (encrypted casts); everything else routes through Phalcon Crypt — recurs A07 BladeView dual-stack pattern exactly. NEW C-area defect class for US-S01: §1 **key-rotation unreachable** (no $previousKeys/getAllKeys/previousKeys/getPreviousKeys, decrypt does not loop) — APP_KEY rotation strands every existing cell/cookie/queueable. Other defects: §2 dual-stack drift (cast ciphertext vs helper ciphertext incompatible), §3 hash() helper returns encrypted ciphertext not a hash (silent-misnaming, recurs as a NAMING-defect family), §4 encrypt() omits json_last_error re-check (silent empty payload on JSON failure), §5 AEAD tag-length not validated (no ensureTagIsValid), §6 IV byte-length not validated, §7 #[\SensitiveParameter] absent on every param (continues C03 (a) security family), §8 generateKey is INSTANCE vs Laravel STATIC (9th same-name/opposite-shape porting hazard — running list now includes B01 create / B02 paginate / B05 rollback / B06 for / B07 simplePaginate / C01 Authenticatable static-vs-instance / C02 login / C03 extend / C04 generateKey), §9 cipher case-sensitive ('AES-256-CBC' rejected), §10 provider closure swallows malformed app.key (no MissingAppKeyException), §11 previousKeys not wired in provider, §12 SerializableClosure::setSecretKey not wired. Missing API: entire key-rotation surface, static supported(), static appearsEncrypted(), MissingAppKeyException, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES, contracts (Encrypter, StringEncrypter — no-contracts pattern continues). Default cipher diverges: Phare aes-256-cbc vs Laravel aes-128-cbc (stronger but wire-incompatible). Cross-cuts US-C02 §3/§4 (recaller cookie payload), US-C05 (CSRF encrypted cookie), US-D01 (queue SerializableClosure), US-E02 (ServiceProvider base + DeferrableProvider), US-E03 (Config), US-E05 (Crypt facade), US-A07 (@encrypted directive).

Csrf and TokenMismatchException ARE Phalcon-clean. First subsystem in 5 to break the A07/C01/C02/C03/C04 provider-boundary-leak streak (NO Providers/CsrfServiceProvider.php — middleware + Csrf are auto-resolved). NEW defect class for US-S01: **CSRF token rotation unreachable** (same family as C04 §1 key-rotation + C03 (e) infinite-rehash) — Csrf::generateToken only fires when session key missing; no regenerateToken on Session\Store (C02 coverage 18/54); login/regenerate never rotate. **Triple-stack** (extends A07/C04 dual-stack class — first triple-stack instance): BladeOne writes \$_SESSION['_token']=token|ip, Csrf writes session['_csrf_token']=token, Laravel writes session['_token']=token — three writers, three formats, one session, silent false-fails on form roundtrips. Wire-incompatibility: VerifyCsrfToken reads X-XSRF-TOKEN as plaintext; Laravel decrypts via injected Encrypter+CookieValuePrefix::remove — Laravel SPAs (Axios/Inertia) silently 419. 10th same-name/opposite-shape porting hazard added: addExcept(array): static (instance) vs static except(\$uris): void (static \$neverVerify). Missing wholesale: encrypter injection (silent-arg-drop family, 4th occurrence after C01/B03/C03), XSRF-TOKEN response cookie (addCookieToResponse/newCookie — blocked on non-existent Phare\Cookie\* subsystem, same NEW-subsystem block as C02 Recaller), Sec-Fetch-Site origin verification + OriginMismatchException, every static API (except/allowSameSite/useOriginOnly/flushState/serialized + static \$neverVerify), ExcludesPaths trait, runningUnitTests skip, Contracts\Security\Csrf (no-contracts pattern 9th subsystem), csrf_token()/csrf_field() helpers (US-E06), @csrf Blade directive wiring (already recorded missing A07). TokenMismatchException namespace divergence: Phare\Middleware vs Laravel Illuminate\Session; Phare hardcodes \$code=419 (Laravel encodes via Exception handler). Csrf::getTokenName()='_token' but storeToken writes session key '_csrf_token' (internal name inconsistency). Cross-cuts US-C04/US-C02/US-A03/US-A07/US-E06. Blocked partly on US-C04 (encrypter), US-C02 (Session\Store::token+regenerateToken), and a new Phare\Cookie\* subsystem.

userStories.notes: Audited 2026-05-27. ### Rate Limiting appended to docs/audit-area-c.md. Effort M. Subsystem files: Phare\RateLimit\{RateLimiter (138 LOC, 11 own pub + Phare-only limit() factory), Limit (60 LOC, 6 statics + 2 instance, $decayMinutes field), TooManyRequestsException (extends \RuntimeException, hardcoded $code=429)} + Phare\Middleware\ThrottleRequests (135 LOC, 1 pub handle()). Subsystem namespace src/Phare/RateLimit/ is Phalcon-CLEAN (zero refs). No RateLimitServiceProvider — RateLimiter is container-auto-resolved (continues C05 no-provider pattern). Phalcon leaks: ➀ inherited contract leak on ThrottleRequests::handle (Phalcon\Http\RequestInterface + ResponseInterface) — counted once at A03 per the C05 dedupe rule; ➁ signature-level on PROTECTED helpers (handleRequestUsingNamedLimiter, handleRequest, resolveRequestSignature, resolveMaxAttempts, addHeaders all type Phalcon\Http\Request/Response — second protected-signature-leak Area-C instance after C05). NEW defect class for US-S01: **service-locator-over-DI** — RateLimiter::__construct(Application) + $this->app->make('cache') instead of typed Contracts\Cache\Repository injection; ThrottleRequests::__construct(Application, RateLimiter) similar shape; latent DI-slot-leak risk if 'cache' binding ever switches to a Phalcon class. NEW defect class for US-S01: **silent-unit-divergence** — Phare `$decayMinutes` vs Laravel `$decaySeconds` on every API (RateLimiter::attempt, Limit::$decayMinutes, ThrottleRequests::handle). A literal `attempt('foo', 5, 60, $cb)` means 60 minutes in Phare and 60 seconds in Laravel — **silent 60× time divergence** undetectable without integration tests. Cross-stack porting will silently extend/shrink decay windows; watch the same pattern for session timeouts, queue retry-after, password-reset TTLs. NEW defect class: **silent-reset on un-cleaned key** — tooManyAttempts/attempts/resetAttempts/remaining/clear/availableIn pass the raw key to cache without cleanRateLimiterKey() first; for HTML-entity-containing keys (user emails with `&`) the timer lookup misses, the >=max branch silently calls resetAttempts, lockout fails AND counter wipes (fail-open AND wipe-history). Same family as B04 un-qualified-column but worse outcome. 11th same-name/opposite-shape porting hazard added: RateLimiter::attempt() — Phare throws TooManyRequestsException on rejection vs Laravel returns false; arg order also inverted (Phare callback last/optional vs Laravel 3rd/required). Silent-arg-drop family extends to 6 instances (B02 update / B03 pivots $touch / C01 attempt|login $remember / C03 silent-config-dropthrough / C05 $encrypter / **C06 hit() $amount** — hit() is hardcoded amount=1, ignores Laravel's $amount). Stub-defect family extends to 9 instances with `Limit::response($callback)` (setter exists but ThrottleRequests::handleRequest reads it NOWHERE). Hardcoded-status-in-Exception pattern recurs (C05 419 → C06 429). Missing wholesale: ThrottleRequestsWithRedis + DurationLimiter (atomic LUA Redis path — concurrency safety blocked on US-D01); GlobalLimit/Unlimited (no instanceof Unlimited short-circuit — `Limit::none()` still calls tooManyAttempts/hit on PHP_INT_MAX); MissingRateLimiterException + ThrottleRequestsException (Phare throws raw \RuntimeException + extends \RuntimeException not Symfony\TooManyRequestsHttpException — handler can't distinguish from generic runtime error, same family as B01 firstOrFail throwing Phalcon Mvc\Model\Exception not ModelNotFoundException); static using/with/shouldHashKeys (named-limiter keys NEVER hashed → PII-in-cache-key risk + cross-limiter collisions); afterCallback plumbing (cannot 'only count failed attempts'); responseCallback dispatch + HttpResponseException for custom 429 bodies; Limit::after/perSecond/fallbackKey + Limit::$afterCallback; InteractsWithTime trait; \UnitEnum support on for()/limiter(); duplicate-key wrap in limiter() (Phare returns raw closure → silent double-hit on duplicate Limit::by keys); increment/decrement; withoutSerializationOrCompression Redis-aware hook (data may double-serialize on Redis); resolveMaxAttempts `'60|120'` guest|user syntax + hasAttribute model property; Retry-After response header on 429 (Phare's `$retryAfter` stored but middleware uses it nowhere). resolveMaxAttempts + resolveRequestSignature read Phalcon `$request->get('authenticated_user')`/`get('user')` — Phalcon GET∪POST input bag, NOT Laravel `$request->user()` model — **trivially client-spoofable** AND unreachable from the actual Auth\Manager. resolveRequestSignature also uses Phalcon `getClientAddress()` + full URI (cardinality explosion on random query params). No Contracts\Cache\RateLimiter (10th subsystem in no-contracts pattern: A06/A07/B06/B07/C01/C02/C03/C04/C05/C06). RateLimiter is auto-resolved (no provider), so named-limiter registrations via RateLimiter::for() are LOST per resolution — limiters config is never invoked by framework anyway (no RouteServiceProvider::configureRateLimiting equivalent). Phare-only API: RateLimiter::limit(int) factory (dead in porting direction). Cross-cuts US-A03 (Middleware contract leak source), US-A04 (Request::route() stub + no $request->user()), US-C01 (Auth identifier source), US-D01 (DurationLimiter Redis path), US-S01 (3 NEW defect classes).
